basic_details.job_title: NBRC Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The National Brain Research Centre (BRIC-NBRC) has invited applications for one post of Project Research Scientist- I under an ICMR small grant project, "Assessment of the effects of odor simulated virtual reality therapy on alleviating craving", whose Project Investigator is Dr. Khushbu Agarwal. The fellowship is ₹56,000 per month plus HRA (as applicable) for 01 year or until the project funds last, whichever is earlier. A Ph.D or equivalent degree with at least one research article in a reputed and indexed journal is essential. Applications go by post to The Administrative Officer (Academics

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form printed with the notice (Advertisement No. Acad./11/2026). Items 1 to 4 are to be written in capital letters.
Attach a detailed curriculum vitae and self-attested copies of certificates of educational qualification and experience.
Attach the category certificate if you are an SC / ST / Physically challenged candidate.
Attach a recent, signed passport size photograph.

Pay the application fee of ₹200 by Demand Draft in favour of 'Director, NBRC, Manesar', or online/via UPI to the 'National Brain Research Centre' account (Account No. 915010023259375, IFSC Code UTIB0000720, Branch: IMT Manesar).
Send the completed application by post to The Administrative Officer (Academics), National Brain Research Centre, Nainwal Mode, Gurugram-122052 (Haryana), so that it reaches by 16 November 2026.
The notice says candidates can apply by post. The heading of the application form also prints the email id [email protected] with the words "Apply online using this email address".
Duly filled application form with the declaration signed and dated
Self-attested copies of certificates of qualification and experience

The form also asks for details of qualifications (institution, board or university, month and year of start and passing, marks percentage, class or division) and of work experience (organisation, designation, total emoluments, length of service, nature of work).
important_instructions: No TA/DA is payable to candidates for attending the interview. Applications without self-attested copies of qualification and experience certificates are rejected without intimation. Incomplete applications are summarily rejected without giving any reason or entertaining correspondence. Information found incorrect or misleading can lead to cancellation of candidature by NBRC at any time.

content_sections.heading: About NBRC
content_sections.text: The National Brain Research Centre is a Deemed University at Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana, and the notice names it BRIC-NBRC. The post is attached to an ICMR small grant project investigating the effects of odor simulated virtual reality therapy on alleviating craving. The Project Investigator is Dr. Khushbu Agarwal, Scientist-III.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable experience: Proficiency in Python/MATLAB, Linux Operating systems Handling Neuroimaging (MRI) data or neurophysiological (EEG/MEG) data Any kind of time series data from real-world measurements Age limit: maximum 45 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D or equivalent degree with at least one research article published in reputed and indexed journal.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is ₹56,000 per month plus HRA (as applicable). No other allowances or benefits are admissible. The tenure is 01 year or till the availability of the project funds, whichever is earlier. It is extendable based on performance review and validity of the project. The post is co-terminus with the project. Accommodation may be provided as per NBRC rules, subject to availability. The job contract is regulated by the terms of the project and the prevailing NBRC rules and procedure.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NBRC Project Research Scientist- I
content_sections.text: The notice says candidates can apply by post. The heading of the application form also prints the email id [email protected] with the words "Apply online using this email address". Duly filled application form with the declaration signed and dated Detailed curriculum vitae Self-attested copies of certificates of qualification and experience Category certificate (SC / ST / Physically challenged) Recent signed passport size photograph The form also asks for details of qualifications (institution, board or university, month and year of start and passing, marks percentage, class or division) and of work experience (organisation, designation, total emoluments, length of service, nature of work).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted, and the decision of the duly constituted Screening Committee is final. Only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience gives no right to be called for interview, and the Centre does not entertain correspondence or interim enquiries on this. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is payable to candidates for attending the interview. Applications without self-attested copies of qualification and experience certificates are rejected without intimation. Incomplete applications are summarily rejected without giving any reason or entertaining correspondence. Information found incorrect or misleading can lead to cancellation of candidature by NBRC at any time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NBRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one position of Project Research Scientist- I under Advertisement No. Acad./11/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NBRC Project Research Scientist- I?
faq.answer: The application must reach by 16 November 2026, sent by post to The Administrative Officer (Academics), National Brain Research Centre, Nainwal Mode, Gurugram-122052 (Haryana).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A Ph.D or equivalent degree with at least one research article published in a reputed and indexed journal is essential.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years, as on the last date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Project Research Scientist- I at NBRC?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹56,000 per month plus HRA (as applicable).

faq.question: Q6. Are other allowances paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: HRA is paid as applicable, but no other allowances or benefits are admissible. Accommodation may be provided as per NBRC rules, subject to availability.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹200, paid by Demand Draft in favour of 'Director, NBRC, Manesar', or online/via UPI to the 'National Brain Research Centre' account.

faq.question: Q8. How is the selection done?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted by the Screening Committee, and only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No regular post is offered. The tenure is 01 year or until project funds are available, whichever is earlier, extendable on performance review and project validity, and the post is co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q10. Is travel allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is payable to candidates for attending the interview.
